The '''''Consular''-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)''', or the '''Republic frigate''', was a model of retrofitted [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] that turned the [[Starship/Legends|ships]] into small [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]]. [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] created this for [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the early part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RepFrig_multiview.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Multiple angled view of a Republic frigate]]

Unlike earlier models, they were not painted entirely in [[Color/Legends|red]], but instead bore an emblem of the [[Open Circle Fleet/Legends|Open Circle Fleet]].<ref name="A" />

The Consulars were armed with five twin [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] cannons, each mounted on the opposing side of the center fuselage and one on the stern behind the sensor and communications array. The class also had a double laser turret on the top of the bow. A smaller sensor and communications array than on the peacetime vessels was featured, and the vessels were staffed by [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilots]] and officers in total of a nine-man crew.<ref name="A" /> The warship also featured a modular bow pod, including the original [[Salon pod/Legends|salon pod]], a command pod, or boarding pods. It was equipped with a class 2 hyperdrive.<ref name="AOR CRB" />

The Consulars were equipped with medical suites complete with a [[2-1B surgical droid]].<ref name="JC" />

The weapons-system had a targeting screen of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] design, similar to the one on the [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|AG-2G quad laser cannon]], an orange-against-red grid.<ref name="TCWEGA" />

The bow-mounted turbolaser was replaced by a turreted twin heavy [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AOR CRB" />

==History==
<div style="float:right">[[File:Republic_frigate.png|thumb|left|200px|A Republic frigate docking with [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']]]]</div>

The refitting-procedure was done early in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when [[Warship/Legends|warships]] were still in short supply.
The former diplomatic ships were converted under direct orders from [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used such a [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] to reach the moon of [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]] for a diplomatic meeting with [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]]. The ship was attacked, but managed to hold off two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] long enough to fire all [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]] towards the moon, one of which contained the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and three [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]].<ref name="A" />

Jedi General [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] attempted to dock one of these ships with the ''[[Resolute/Legends|Resolute]] ''to treat [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker's]] severe injury, following with the ship's hyperdrive malfunctioning and the ship blasting into hyperspace. After nearly flying into a star, the ''Consular''-class ship crash-landed on [[Maridun/Legends|Maridun]].

They were also used to transfer captured [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] to the [[Tranquility/Legends|''Tranquility'']], and later when Gunray and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] made their escape.<ref name="COD">{{TCW|Cloak of Darkness}}</ref> Consulars also evacuated the crew from the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']] during the [[Sky Battle of Quell]].<ref name="JC">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref> A number of these militarized ''Consular''-class cruisers were part of a task force assigned to free captured [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Eeth Koth/Legends|Eeth Koth]] who had been captured by Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="GI">{{TCW|Grievous Intrigue}}</ref> They were used to transport the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] to the [[Endurance/Legends|''Endurance'']] as well.

One of these ships was used to transport the body of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] back to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] after his [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="SM">{{TCW|Senate Murders}}</ref> Later in the war, at least three were part of the [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|battled]] over [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]].<ref name="Night">{{TCW|Nightsisters (episode)}}</ref>

Another of these vessels was used to transport [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] to the planet [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] for a [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|failed diplomatic mission]]. It was destroyed on orders from the Separatist commander [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]].<ref name="Water War">{{TCW|Water War}}</ref>

Following the [[Declaration of a New Order]], few of the starships survived, with many having been mothballed or broken up. During the Galactic Civil War, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] deployed several of them. They were known to be well-liked by their crews.<ref name="AOR CRB" />
